description: Operator-supplied access-policy oracle for OWASP Juice Shop. This is EXTERNAL GROUND TRUTH (like an API spec / authorization matrix), not a Sentinel finding. Each rule declares what SHOULD be true; Sentinel freshly re-probes the live target and only reports a finding when observed behaviour contradicts the declared policy. Juice Shop is only the test fixture — the engine itself is target-agnostic.

rules.note: Feedback submitted by all users must not be readable without authentication. Juice Shop is expected to leak the whole collection to anonymous callers (a real broken-access-control flaw), so the judge should reproduce the contradiction and CONFIRM this.

Anonymous enumeration of all user accounts must be denied. If the target honours this (returns 401/403), the deterministic judge returns DISPROVED and NO finding is produced — demonstrating that Sentinel does not manufacture findings.
